intended_values: An effective criterion for prescribed block-code extensions; Alec Kriebel; version 1.0; preprint date 2026-10-16; problem 4600024; https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/781. Complete computable criterion for each specified onto block self-map of a nonempty two-sided irreducible sofic shift to extend into the shift from a containing SFT. All local-rule completions, extension radii and larger containing alphabets are covered. This includes Boyle16.3's mixing case and uses the credited published PRZ2014 separation bound. Separate existence-over-all-maps, CA-stability and arbitrary reducible-sofic classifications are outside the result. Extensive AI use; unrefereed, no external human peer review or formal proof verification. Earlier Dykstra2007 steadiness/problem formulation, Barth-Dykstra terminology credited via Ballier, Ballier's2013/2015 canonical approximation normalization/restricted results, and PRZ2014 Theorem4.2 are credited. Bounded primary-source reviews verified no full predecessor in inspected statements; originality, firstness and present worldwide openness remain unestablished, with inaccessible/version/indexing gaps explicit. Deposit includes PDF and source/verification archive.
